summary: Comprehensive testing of Zektrix UK chat, push notification, and auth fixes (iteration 11). All 15 backend API tests passed. All 6 frontend UI tests passed. The NEW fixes are verified working: REST API fallback for LiveChat, Admin chat polling, Chat escalation, Push subscription, VAPID key endpoint, Admin reply, and Auth callback page.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 during initial render - non-blocking cosmetic issue from recharts library

VAPID_KEY_ENDPOINT.description: Returns valid VAPID public key for push notification subscription

PUSH_SUBSCRIBE_ADMIN.description: Admin can subscribe to push notifications, non-admin users correctly rejected with 403

AI_CHAT.description: AI chat responds to messages with session tracking

CHAT_ESCALATE.description: Chat escalation creates message_id and notifies admins via WebSocket and email

CHAT_MESSAGE_REST.description: REST API fallback for live chat when WebSocket is unavailable - matches FAQ or forwards to support

CHAT_HISTORY.description: User chat history with no duplicate message_ids - loadHistory replaces instead of appending

ADMIN_CHAT_MESSAGES.description: Admin polling endpoint for chat messages with status filter support

ADMIN_CHAT_REPLY.description: Admin can reply to user chat messages, sends WebSocket notification and email

AUTH_CALLBACK_PAGE.description: Auth callback page loads correctly, handles session_id from hash or window.location.hash fallback

CHAT_WIDGET_UI.description: Chat widget opens with data-testid='chat-window', shows 4 quick questions, input disabled when not logged in, enabled when logged in

GOOGLE_LOGIN_BUTTON.description: Google login button 'Continuă cu Google' visible on login page

PUSH_NOTIFICATION_UI.description: Admin Settings tab shows 'Notificări Push pe Telefon' section with 'Activează Notificări Push' button

WS_TOKEN_VERIFICATION.description: verify_ws_token supports both JWT and session tokens (line ~2899 in server.py)

BUG_1_PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Push notification infrastructure working: VAPID key endpoint, subscribe endpoint for admin, vapid_private.pem used for webpush. Note: Actual delivery to phone requires browser permission and service worker registration - infrastructure verified.

BUG_2_LIVE_CHAT.description: Live chat has REST API fallback via POST /api/chat/message when WebSocket unavailable. Admin page polls every 8s for new messages. User LiveChat polls every 5s when WS is down. Chat history replaces messages to avoid duplicates.

BUG_3_GOOGLE_AUTH.description: Google Auth button visible, AuthCallback.js handles session_id from URL hash (both location.hash and window.location.hash fallback), verify_ws_token supports session tokens for Google Auth users

critical_code_review_comments: WebSocket connection fails in preview environment due to K8s ingress only routing /api paths - this is expected and the REST API polling fallback handles it correctly
recharts library console warnings about -1 width/height during initial render are cosmetic only
seed_data_creation: Created test user and chat messages during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three bug fixes verified: 1) Push notifications - VAPID key works, subscribe endpoint stores data, admin Settings tab has enable button. 2) Live chat - REST API fallback at POST /chat/message, admin polls every 8s, user polls every 5s when WS down, loadHistory replaces messages. 3) Google Auth - button visible, AuthCallback handles hash fragment, verify_ws_token supports session tokens. WebSocket connections may fail in preview environment but REST API polling handles it.
websocket_note: WebSocket endpoints /ws/chat/user and /ws/chat/admin are NOT prefixed with /api, so K8s ingress doesn't route them to backend. This is expected behavior in preview environment. The REST API polling fallback (every 5-8 seconds) ensures chat functionality works without WebSocket.
